slides.title: Passive voice: present and past simple
slides.subtitle: When the action matters more than who does it
goals: Form **am / is / are + participle** and **was / were + participle**.
Use **by** to say who did it.

slides.title: Form
slides.tip: Use the passive when the doer is unknown, obvious or unimportant: *English **is spoken** all over the world.*

items.en: The Pyramid of the Sun was built around 200 AD.
Our exams are checked by two teachers.
Was the email sent? — Yes, it was.

items.t: People speak Spanish in Mexico. → Spanish ___ spoken in Mexico.
They cancelled the flight. → The flight was ___.
Who wrote this song? → Who was this song written ___?

items.q: The thief ___ by the police yesterday.
